plain: A small group of features and the weights between them that together compute one thing.
eli5: A few parts of the robot's brain that pass a message along to do one small job, like spotting a wheel and a window to see a car.
technical: A subgraph of a network (features plus the weights connecting them) that implements an identifiable computation, such as a car detector built from wheel and window detectors, or an induction head.
